issues.detail: Hebrew 'לְמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל' means 'according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel' (i.e., twelve tribes). The Chinese renders '按以色列兒子們的杖的數目' ('according to the number of the staffs/rods of the children of Israel'), introducing '杖' (staff/rod) which is not in the Hebrew text. This changes the meaning from 'tribes' to 'staffs'.
